ei.title: The Future of AI and Its Impact
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.

questions.passage: You may have seen headlines in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to (A)[consider / ignore] all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it (B)[prevents / enables] machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core difference between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to (C)[recognize / overlook] the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ① (A) consider(고려하다) (B) enables(가능하게 하다) (C) recognize(인식하다) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
✅ ① consider(고려하다) + enables(가능하게 하다) + recognize(인식하다) ← 정답
❌ ② ignore(무시하다) ≠ consider, overlook(간과하다) ≠ recognize
❌ ③ prevents(막다) ≠ enables
❌ ④ 3개 모두 오류

det.korean: ③ (A) perform(수행하다) (B) specific(특화된) (C) self-improve(스스로 개선하다) 원문 그대로

questions.passage: You may have seen ①<u>headlines</u> in the news about some of the things machines powered by artificial intelligence can do. However, if you were to consider all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually ②<u>forget</u>, it would be quite mind-blowing! One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it ③<u>enables</u> machines to learn new things, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to ④<u>recognize</u> the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② forget(잊다) → perform(수행하다): AI 기계가 실제로 '수행할' 수 있는 작업
det.analysis:
❌ ① headlines: 'seen headlines in the news' 헤드라인 — 적절
✅ ② forget → perform: 'all the tasks that AI-powered machines could actually perform' — AI 기계가 실제로 '수행할(perform)' 수 있는 작업. forget(잊다)은 문맥 부적합 ← 정답
❌ ③ enables: 'enables machines to learn' 가능하게 하다 — 적절
❌ ④ recognize: 'recognize the implications' 인식하다 — 적절

One of the key features of artificial intelligence is that it enables machines to ①<u>forget new things</u>, rather than requiring programming specific to new tasks. Therefore, the core ②<u>difference</u> between computers of the future and those of the past is that future computers will be able to learn and self-improve. In the near future, smart virtual assistants will know more about you than your ③<u>closest</u> friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① forget(잊다) → learn(학습하다): AI는 기계가 새로운 것을 '학습하게' 한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① forget new things → learn new things: 'it enables machines to learn new things' — AI의 핵심은 기계가 새로운 것을 '학습하게(learn)' 하는 것. forget(잊다)은 정반대 ← 정답
❌ ② difference: 'the core difference' 차이 — 적절
❌ ③ closest: 'your closest friends' 가장 가까운 — 적절
❌ ④ implications: 'the implications' 영향 — 적절
det.tip: learn new things(새로운 것을 학습하다) ↔ forget(잊다)

In the near future, smart virtual assistants will __________ than your closest friends and family members do. Can you imagine how that might change our lives? These kinds of changes are exactly why it is so important to recognize the implications that new technologies will have for our world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 know more about you(당신에 대해 더 많이 알다)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① forget everything quickly(모든 것을 빨리 잊다): AI 강점과 반대
❌ ② ask you fewer questions(질문을 덜 하다): 문맥 부적합
❌ ③ cost far less money(비용이 덜 들다): 본문 근거 없음
✅ ④ know more about you(당신에 대해 더 많이 알다): 'smart virtual assistants will __________ than your closest friends and family members do' — 스마트 비서가 가까운 친구·가족보다 당신을 더 많이 알게 될 것 ← 정답
det.tip: know more about you than ~ do = ~보다 당신을 더 많이 알다
